kurzfassung: Danny Pellegrino struggles through a supersized, disappointing episode of Real Housewives of Orange County while discussing broader Bravo news and a chaotic grocery store trip. The episode features predictable cast feuds, Heather apologizing to Carmela, and Tamra's bizarre hotel seduction scene with Eddie. Danny threatens to drop his coverage of the franchise entirely if the next episode does not improve.
